dedupe_keys.name: delimitation maritime limite exterieure de la zone economique exclusive 200 milles

description: Délimitation maritime - Limite extérieure de la zone économique exclusive (200 milles) is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by limitesmaritimes.gouv.fr. In accordance with Article 57 of UNCLOS, the outer boundary of the Exclusive Economic Zone (EEZ) is 200 nautical miles from the baselines. This boundary separates the EEZ from the high seas. Beyond this limit, an extension of the continental shelf is possible subject to the criteria of Article 76 of UNCLOS. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Maritime Delimitation – External Limit of the Exclusive Economic Zone (200 miles)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include données ouvertes, zone économique exclusive, 200 milles, droit de la mer, ZEE, réglementation. The listing shows 3 download or service links in WMS, WFS. The listing shows 2020-06-11 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
